decisions.reason: Proven government adoption and over 30 APIS connections show its value has resolved favourably, so the firm should commit further rather than abandon it.
The training module costs little to maintain with the firm's certified trainers, and its uncertain upside in new sectors still justifies holding the option despite no reported results.
Behaviour analysis is central to the firm's specialist detection capabilities and its potential in new sectors is still unresolved, so the option remains worth keeping.
Passenger profiling draws on core aviation security know-how at low carrying cost, and its value is not yet disproven, so retaining it preserves upside.
The verification platform is close to the established offer and cheap to sustain, though dropping the related travel health API raises some risk, so it is kept while its results develop.
